# Qwerty.School

> > Qwerty.School is an online learning platform offering typing tests, keyboard shortcut guides, and self-paced courses in productivity, testing, financial literacy, and personal development.

The platform provides comprehensive typing speed assessments in multiple languages, extensive hotkey references for popular software like Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets, and structured courses covering topics from QA testing fundamentals to time management using SMART methodology.

## Key Topics

- Typing speed tests and practice
- Keyboard shortcuts and hotkeys
- Touch typing with ten-finger method
- SMART goal-setting methodology
- QA testing fundamentals
- Time management techniques
- Financial literacy and budgeting
- Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, Google Sheets
- Windows, macOS, Linux platforms
- Self-paced online learning
- Productivity optimization
- Personal development
- Freelance earning strategies
- Biohacking and lifestyle improvement

## Typing Tests & Learning

- [100-word typing speed test](https://qwerty.school/typing/test/100-words): English 100-word typing speed and accuracy assessment test
- [Тест скорости печати на 100 слов бесплатно](https://qwerty.school/ru/typing/test/100-words): 100-word Russian typing speed test for assessing keyboard skills
- [Советы по обучению печати](https://qwerty.school/ru/typing/learn): Touch typing tutorial with ten-finger method and posture tips

## Online Courses

- [Курс «Основы тестирования»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/courses/osnovy-testirovaniya): QA testing fundamentals course covering methodology and tools
- [Курс «Управление временем»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/courses/upravlenie-vremenem): Time management course with SMART goals and Eisenhower matrix methods
- [Курс «Из мечты в цель»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/courses/iz-mechty-v-tsel): Goal-setting course teaching SMART methodology and progress tracking
- [Курс «Финансовая грамотность»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/courses/finansovaya-gramotnost): Financial literacy course covering budgeting and investing basics
- [Курс «Заработок в интернете»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/ru/courses/zarabotok-v-internete): Freelance earning course from profile creation to financial analysis
- [Курс «Биохакинг»: онлайн обучение в Qwerty.School](https://qwerty.school/ru/courses/biohaking): Biohacking course for energy optimization and lifestyle improvement

## Keyboard Shortcuts Reference

- [LibreOffice Keyboard Shortcuts — Complete Guide to All Key Combinations for Writer, Calc, Impress and Other Modules](https://qwerty.school/hotkeys/libreoffice): Complete LibreOffice hotkeys for Writer, Calc, Impress across platforms
- [Google Sheets Keyboard Shortcuts — Complete Guide to All Combinations for Windows, macOS and Chrome OS](https://qwerty.school/hotkeys/google-sheets): Google Sheets hotkeys for navigation, formulas, and formatting
- [Mozilla Firefox Hotkeys – All the Shortcuts for Faster Browser Operations](https://qwerty.school/hotkeys/mozilla): Firefox keyboard shortcuts for tabs, navigation, and developer tools
- [WordPad Keyboard Shortcuts — All Combinations for Efficient Text Editing](https://qwerty.school/hotkeys/wordpad): WordPad hotkeys guide for Windows text editor productivity
